description.text: Root files for the first create, including LICENSE from the project license and a slim .gitignore. version.json is not a checkbox here; choose This repository on a first create to add the root file. Visual Studio requires at least one value; choose None when adding another library to the same repository.

Where this library's .slnx is written. Default src/sln/{name}/ with the handbook beside that file. Other locations: repository root (src/sln/{name}/ stays as notes), or src/prj/{name}/ next to the library csproj (slnx and handbook; no src/sln/{name}/). Several .slnx files in the same folder make `dotnet` require an explicit path (MSB1011). Visual Studio also creates a root .slnx; close Visual Studio, open the template solution, and delete the extra root .slnx.
Checked values write explicit C# and debug properties on the packable project. XML documentation is project-only. Uncheck one to write the alternative.

Default is This library (Properties/version.json) on every create. This repository writes root version.json on a first create; later libraries keep This repository and choose None for root items. Off keeps VersionPrefix in the library project.

Optional DocShell.html seed. NuGet package docs go under this library's Properties/NugetAssets/docs and pack with the nupkg. Repository docs go under docs/ at the repo root (first create only). Choose None when adding another library unless you only want package docs. Bootstrap and mini docs are a checkpoint task.
Default MIT. Standard licenses set PackageLicenseExpression and keep License.txt on disk. Custom packs License.txt as the NuGet license file. The LICENSE file at repository root copies this license.

name.text: Treat high/critical NuGet vulnerabilities as errors

description.text: Default on. Restore fails this packable project on high (NU1903) and critical (NU1904) vulnerable packages. Low and moderate stay warnings. Uncheck for an EOL or backport graph.

Default off. Writes empty Directory.Build.props and Directory.Build.targets beside this library, and Directory.Solution.props and Directory.Solution.targets beside this library's .slnx. Landing files for extra MSBuild. No Directory.Packages.props.
Default on. Writes an empty .config/dotnet-tools.json beside this library (no tools). Landing file for dotnet tool install --local. Uncheck to skip. Does not restore tools on build.
